title: Japan Honors Director Rintarō as Person of Cultural Merit
content: Rintarō 's real name is Shigeyuki Hayashi . The director is currently 85 years old. The director is in charge of the original story draft for Toei Animation 's new anime film based on Leiji Matsumoto 's Galaxy Express 999 franchise .

title: Land of the Lustrous' Haruko Ichikawa Launches New Manga Cosmic Mimimi
content: The December issue of Kodansha 's monthly Afternoon magazine announced on Friday Haruko Ichikawa will launch a new series titled Cosmic Mimimi in the next issue on November 25. The "neo kawaii sci-fi" series follows Mimimi, who lives in a "cool" and "dreaming" city. Its goal is to make everyone happy.
author: ANN

title: Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc Anime Gets English Dub on Crunchyroll
content: Crunchyroll announced on Saturday that it is now streaming an English dub for the first two episodes of the Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc television anime based on Yura Urushibara 's Tougen Anki: Legend of the Cursed Blood manga. The announcement did not mention the English dub cast.
author: ANN

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Dr. Stone
content: Dr. Stone confirmed its anime sequel only a few months after the series wrapped up its main story. The anime reached its conclusion in June this year, seven years after its premiere.

title: Netflix’s One Piece Star Drops Ominous Season 3 Tease: “My Plan Unfolds”
content: One Piece is now in the works on the third season of its live-action series coming to Netflix next year, and the star behind Crocodile is readying fans for his return in the new episodes with an ominous tease.

title: Live-Action 5 Centimeters Per Second Film Opens in Indian Theaters on October 30
content: The film opened in Japan in October 2025, and ranked at #2 in its opening weekend. The film sold 278,000 tickets and earned 420 million yen (about US$2.78 million) in its first three days. SixTONES member Hokuto Matsumura ( Suzume 's Sōta Munakata) stars in the live-action film.
author: ANN

title: Anime Times Streams Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden Anime in India
content: Anime Times began streaming the television anime of Umikaze Minamino 's Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden ( Kyōran Reijō Nia Liston: Byōjaku Reijō ni Tenseishita Kami-goroshi no Bujin no Kareinaru Musō Roku ) light novel series on Amazon Prime Video in India on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Dandadan Studio’s Ghost in the Shell Reboot Confirmed to Continue With Sequel
content: The new Ghost in the Shell reboot anime series from the s ame studio behind hits like DAN DA DAN has announced it’s now working on a new anime project for the franchise. Out of all the science fiction anime franchises out there, Masamune Shirow’s Ghost in the Shell is likely one of the most famous.
